source.name: Crimson Guard
source.description:
+5 armor, Block 30 damage.

Active ability: Activates when taking damage
Grants all allies within the range 50% chance to block 100 damage for melee pieces and 30 damage for ranged pieces. Lasts 8 sec.

Range: 400
